source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 18.9.1 with Figures 18.11 and 18.12 and the Interesting Information box, printed pages 28-29.

blocks.text: In isomers mein ek jaise ligands ya to saath saath (adjacent, 90° angle, cis) hote hain ya aamne saamne (opposite, 180° angle, trans). Yeh square planar complexes (maslan [Pt(NH₃)₂Cl₂]) aur octahedral complexes (maslan [Co(NH₃)₄Cl₂]) mein aam hai.

[Pt(NH₃)₂Cl₂] ke cis aur trans isomers Figure 18.11 mein hain. cis-[Pt(NH₃)₂Cl₂] (cisplatin) mein dono chlorine atoms square complex mein saath saath, 90° par hain, jab ke trans-[Pt(NH₃)₂Cl₂] (transplatin) mein aamne saamne, 180° par. In geometrical isomers ki properties alag hain: dilchasp baat yeh hai ke cisplatin cancer ki dawa hai, jab ke transplatin mein yeh property (khoobi) nahi.

blocks.alt: Dashed square par bane do square-planar Pt complexes. cis-platin: dono Cl baen konon par aur dono NH3 daen konon par, yani Cl saath saath. trans-platin: Cl peechhe baen aur aage daen, NH3 peechhe daen aur H3N aage baen, yani Cl aamne saamne.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.11: Geometrical isomers, cisplatin aur transplatin (kitab ki Figure 18.11 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Cisplatin mein dono Cl 90° par hain, is liye bond dipoles cancel nahi hote aur molecule polar hai; transplatin mein Cl 180° par hain, dipoles cancel ho jate hain aur molecule non-polar hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 18.11 mein beech ka platinum (Pt) atom nahi chhapa; drawing mein Pt beech mein dikhaya gaya hai.

Transplatin mein ek jaise ligands ke bond dipoles ulti directions (simton) mein hain aur ek doosre ko cancel kar dete hain, is liye molecule nonpolar hai. Cisplatin mein yeh bond moments cancel nahi hote; dipole moment zero nahi rehta aur molecule polar hai.

blocks.title: Interesting Information (dilchasp maloomat)
blocks.text: Cisplatin, yani cis-diamminedichloroplatinum(II), cancer ki ek landmark (sang-e-meel, bohat ahem) inorganic dawa hai. Yeh accidentally (ittefaq se) discover hui, jab dekha gaya ke platinum electrodes bacteria ke cells ki division (taqseem) rok dete hain. Yeh tezi se badhne wale cancer cells mein dakhil hoti hai; wahan ligand exchange hota hai aur paani is ke chloride ions ki jagah le leta hai. Phir yeh "activated" dawa DNA ke guanine bases se jud kar double helix ke dhaagon ko aapas mein jor deti hai (cross-links). Is nuqsan se DNA ki replication (naqal) ruk jati hai aur cell ki programmed maut (apoptosis) shuru ho jati hai.

[Co(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]³⁺ ek [MA₄B₂] type ka octahedral complex hai (chaar ek jaise ligands A aur do ek jaise ligands B). Is ke cis aur trans isomers Figure 18.12 mein hain. Cis isomer mein dono H₂O ligands saath saath, 90° par, aur trans isomer mein aamne saamne, 180° par hain.

blocks.alt: OCTAHEDRAL COMPLEX ION ki heading ke neeche [Co(NH3)4(H2O)2]3+ ki do drawings, har aik mein Co se guzarta peela square plane aur aik ligand oopar aur aik neeche. cis-isomer: aik H2O plane ke oopar aur doosra plane ke kone par, 90 degree par. trans-isomer: dono H2O plane ke aamne saamne konon par, 180 degree par; NH3 oopar aur neeche.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.12: [Co(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]³⁺ ke geometrical isomers (kitab ki Figure 18.12 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing, us ke do isomers ki shakal mein).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 18.12 chaar drawings (i) se (iv) chhaapti hai, jaise chaar isomers hon. In mein (i), (ii) aur (iv) ek hi cis isomer hain (dono H₂O 90° par, bas alag alag angle se bane), aur (iii) trans isomer hai (180°). [MA₄B₂] octahedral complex ke sirf do geometrical isomers hote hain, cis aur trans; drawing mein yahi do bane hain.

blocks.prompt: [Pt(NH₃)₂Cl₂] ka kaun sa isomer polar hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Cis isomer: is ke do Pt–Cl bond dipoles 90° par hain aur cancel nahi hote, is liye molecule ka dipole moment hai.

items: cis: ek jaise ligands 90° par; trans: 180° par.
Cisplatin polar aur cancer ki dawa; transplatin non-polar.
[Co(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]³⁺ jaise octahedral [MA₄B₂] complexes bhi cis-trans isomerism dikhate hain.
